   354  /* nmea_checksum(*errout, buf) -- check NMEA checksum for message in buffer.
   355   * Also handles !AI checksums.
   356   *
   357   * Return: True = Checksum good
   358   *         False -- checksum bad
   359   */
   360  static bool nmea_checksum(const struct gpsd_errout_t *errout,
   361                            const char *buf, const char *endp)
   362  {
   363      bool checksum_ok = true;
   364      const char *end;
   365      unsigned int n, csum = 0;
   366      char csum_s[3] = { '0', '0', '0' };
   367
   368      /* These have no checksum:
   369       *  GPS-320FW emits $PLCS
   370       *  MTK-3301 emits $POLYN
   371       *  Skytraq S2525F8-BD-RTK emits $STI
   372       *  Telit SL869 emits $GPTXT
   373       *  Ashtech (old!) $PASHR,MCA and $PASHR,PBN with no checksum
   374       * All undocumented,  Let them fail, except $STI.
   375       */
   376      if (str_starts_with(buf, "$STI,")) {
   377          // Let this one go...
   378          return true;
   379      }
   380
   381      /* Some messages, like !AIVMD, !AIVMO, can have "stuff" after the
   382       * checksum.  Some messages can have "*" in the body of a message.
   383       * At least one GPS (the Firefly 1a) emits \r\r\n at the end.
   384       *
   385       * So scan backwards until we find the *.  Use the 2 chars to the
   386       * right as the checksum.
   387       */
   388      for (end = endp - 1; buf < end; end--) {
   389          if ('*' == *end) {
   390              break;
   391          }
   392      }
   393
   394      if ('*' != *end) {
   395          // no asterisk found
   396          return false;
   397      }
   398
   399      /* Verify checksum is 2 hex digits.  Irnoge trailing stuff.
   400       * Magellan EC-10X has lower case hex in checksum. It is rare.  */
   401      if (!isxdigit(end[1]) ||
   402          !isxdigit(end[2])) {
   403          return false;
   404      }
   405
   406      // compute the checksum
   407      for (n = 1; buf + n < end; n++) {
   408          csum ^= buf[n];
   409      }
   410      (void)snprintf(csum_s, sizeof(csum_s), "%02X", csum);
   411      checksum_ok = (csum_s[0] == toupper((int)end[1]) &&
   412                     csum_s[1] == toupper((int)end[2]));
   413      if (!checksum_ok) {
   414          GPSD_LOG(LOG_WARN, errout,
   415                   "bad checksum in NMEA packet; got %c%c expected %s.\n",
   416                   end[1], end[2], csum_s);
   417      }
   418
   419      return checksum_ok;
   420  }
